actions.description: Create a deal group (pipeline) in ActiveCampaign.
actions.name: create-deal-group

currency.description: Default currency for new deals in this pipeline. Example: "usd"

allgroups.description: Whether all user groups can manage this pipeline. 1 = yes, 0 = no. Default: 1

allusers.description: Whether new deals are auto-assigned to all users. 1 = yes, 0 = no. Default: 0

autoassign.description: Deal auto-assign mode. 0 = disabled, 1 = round robin, 2 = by value. Default: 1

users.description: List of user IDs to auto-assign new deals to when auto-assign is enabled.

groups.description: List of user group IDs allowed to manage this pipeline when allgroups is 0.

actions.description: Create a deal stage in ActiveCampaign.
actions.name: create-deal-stage

order.description: Order of the deal stage within the pipeline. Example: 1

dealOrder.description: Option and direction to sort deals in the stage. Example: "next-action DESC"

cardRegion1.description: What to show in upper-left corner of Deal Cards. Example: "title"

cardRegion2.description: What to show in upper-right corner of Deal Cards. Example: "next-action"

cardRegion3.description: Whether to show the avatar in Deal Cards. Example: "show-avatar"

cardRegion4.description: What to show next to the avatar in Deal Cards. Example: "contact-fullname-orgname"

cardRegion5.description: What to show in lower-right corner of Deal Cards. Example: "value"

color.description: Deal Stage color as 6-character HEX without hashtag. Example: "32B0FC"

width.description: Deal stage width in pixels. Example: 280

reorder.description: Whether to reorder stages after creation. Can be 0 or 1.

actions.description: Create a deal in ActiveCampaign.
actions.name: create-deal

description.description: Deal description. Example: "This deal is an important deal"

currency.description: Deal currency in 3-digit ISO format, lowercased. Example: "usd"

customFieldId.description: Field ID, ID of the Custom Field Meta Data. Example: 1

fieldValue.description: Updated field value. Example: "First field value"

fieldCurrency.description: Required only for the currency field type. Example: "EUR"

actions.description: Create a list in ActiveCampaign.

name.description: Name of the list to create. Example: "Newsletter Subscribers"

sender_url.description: The website URL this list is for. Example: "https://example.com"

sender_reminder.description: A reminder for contacts as to why they are on this list. Example: "You subscribed via our website."

channel.description: Type of channel for the list. Possible values are `email` or `sms`. Defaults to `email`.

send_last_broadcast.description: Whether to send the last sent campaign to a new subscriber upon subscribing.

carboncopy.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to copy on all mailings.

subscription_notify.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to notify when a new subscriber joins.

unsubscription_notify.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to notify when a subscriber unsubscribes.

user.description: User ID of the list owner.
